newsitem.title: FRANCE: China buys 150,000 tonnes EU malting barley.
newsitem.headline: China buys 150,000 tonnes EU malting barley.

text.p: China recently bought 150,000 tonnes of European Union malting barley at around $200 per tonne, including cost and freight, European grain traders said on Tuesday.
The barley is for shipment in November, December and January, they said.
China traditionally buys malting barley from Canada and Australia.
But Canadian barley has become less competitive after being hit by early snow.
China turned to the EU mostly because it has a bumper crop and competitive prices, traders said ,
France, Spain and Denmark are the top suppliers of spring and winter malting barley within the EU.
China traditionally imports up to 1.5 million tonnes of malting barley for its brewing industry.
It has bought 300,000 tonnes from Canada, 300,000 tonnes from Australia and 150,000 from the EU, traders estimated.
"They have already covered half of their import needs for the season," one trader said.
Traders expect China to shop again for malting barley in April-May-June.
